headline: Spotify's Nov 24 login outage lasted about an hour. Spotify has not given a cause, and nobody has reported a hack.
summary: First draft. 5 sources (all Tier 2), 8 claims (2 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 2 Not established), 4 questions. The outage and Spotify's acknowledgement are Confirmed by a first-hand check and several outlets. Recovery is Reported: one outlet's first-hand check and a Spotify post relayed by one outlet. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
